classification.difficultyReason: Read quartiles from two cumulative histograms, calculate both IQRs and justify a comparison of consistency.

inlines.text: Two cumulative frequency histograms display the battery life (in hours) of two different phone brands. Each brand tested 80 batteries.
Calculate the IQR for both. Which brand has a more consistent middle 50% of battery lives? Justify your answer using your calculations.

spec.description: Brand A cumulative histogram with unfilled bars and a common vertical scale for comparison with Brand B.

answer.short: Brand A: $4-2=2$ hours. Brand B: $4-4=0$ hours. Brand B is more consistent because its IQR is smaller.
answer.worked:
For each brand, the total frequency is $80$.
$$\begin{align*}Q_1\text{ position}&=0.25\times80=20\\Q_3\text{ position}&=0.75\times80=60\end{align*}$$
For Brand A, the 20th value is $2$ hours and the 60th value is $4$ hours.
$$\mathrm{IQR}_A=4-2=2\text{ hours}$$
For Brand B, both the 20th and 60th values are $4$ hours.
$$\mathrm{IQR}_B=4-4=0\text{ hours}$$
Brand B has the more consistent middle $50\%$ of battery lives because its IQR is smaller.
